messages:
Ravi - AE: FYI Malachite (healthtech) asked for a 10-day POC to validate a custom 7B variant + embeddings endpoint. They need streaming chat + <120ms p50 per token and HIPAA/SOC2 scope.
Clara - Sales Eng: Do we know model format/quant? Any finetune libs (LoRA?)
Ravi - AE: customer says 'qlora-nf4' checkpoint, includes tokenizer.json and adapter.safetensors.
Ivy - ML Eng: qlora + nf4 is doable but runtime needs a compatibility sweep. Custom tokenizer can be remapped but adapters sometimes need an attention kernel shim. I'll run a quick check.
Ivy - ML Eng: Running: `inference-scan --input malachite7b_q4_nf4.tar.gz --check-tokenizer --check-kv --simulate-stream`
InfraBot: Capacity probe: pool "us-east-poc" has 2x A100 + 1x T4 spare for POC windows. :white_check_mark:
Ivy - ML Eng: Scan output: tokenizer loaded, found 12 OOV tokens -> will map. Model loads but attention kernel mismatch on block 9: fallback to slower kernel currently.
Ivy - ML Eng: Shorthand: needs adapter patch + small runtime fallback; estimate 36-48h engineering work + 24h perf validation. p50 after patch ~90-110ms token on A100 with batching tuned.
Clara - Sales Eng: Timeline note for customer and legal. If we need 2 days of eng work, we should flag schedule and price accordingly.
Noor - Security: HIPAA requires Private or Dedicated with DPA and BAA signed. BYOK for keys? Yes for Private, need KMS details and key policy. Also need their SOC2 attestation and data flow diagram.
Ravi - AE: Malachite prefers BYOK and said their infra team will share KMS ARN. I'll ask for DPA + KMS within 3 business days.
LegalBot: Reminder: Attach standard POC SOW + provisional DPA template. No data ingress until DPA signed.
Clara - Sales Eng: Pricing proposal for 10-day POC: $3,500 reserved (includes one reserved GPU for baseline tests) + $0.60 per 1k tokens over sample allowance. Conditional on adapter being completed within schedule.
Ravi - AE: I'll present that as provisional. Also calling out that if adapter work pushes into >5 business days, we re-evaluate scope.
Ivy - ML Eng: I'll open ENG ticket ENG-8205 for adapter + perf matrix. Will include test vectors and streaming regression tests. ETA: patch in 48h, validation 24h.
Noor - Security: I'll send the security questionnaire and a checklist (KMS ARN, key policy, SOC2 cert, contact). Need answers within 5 business days to keep timeline.
Clara - Sales Eng: Action items: Ravi to collect DPA/KMS, Ivy to deliver ENG-8205, Noor to circulate sec questions, Clara to send provisional quote and schedule kickoff.
Ravi - AE: Scheduling kickoff with customer for next Wednesday. Will post customer replies here. :calendar: 
Ivy - ML Eng: Quick note: if nf4 fallback persists on A100 we might recommend a quant re-export (qint8) which could change latency/cost profile. Will include alternative recommendations in ENG ticket.
Clara - Sales Eng: Thanks all. I'll loop in Solutions and Legal on the thread. :+1:
